name: LiveClin
description: LiveClin is a live clinical benchmark designed to avoid data leakage and knowledge obsolescence by using contemporary, peer-reviewed case reports updated biannually. It includes 1,407 case reports and 6,605 questions spanning complex, multimodal clinical scenarios to evaluate medical LLMs in real-world clinical practice.
reputation: A new live medical benchmark that is notable for emphasizing up-to-date, leakage-resistant evaluation on contemporary clinical case reports.
notes: Continuously updated benchmark with verified AI-human workflow; highlights gap between models and human experts.
